summary: Tested new httpOnly-cookie JWT auth + admin delete-user feature. Backend pytest (9 new tests) all passed. Frontend Playwright E2E (6 scenarios) all passed: elite login sets httpOnly+Secure cookie and no token in localStorage; page refresh restores session via /api/auth/me cookie; all 5 dashboard pages load with cookie; logout clears cookie and blocks /dashboard access; admin can delete a throwaway user (row disappears, cascade works); admin self-delete is rejected with a toast (backend 400) and admin row remains.
critical_code_review_comments: auth_routes.py cookie is set with SameSite=Lax but browser reports SameSite=None because Secure=True + cross-context; actual attribute sent is 'lax' (fine, browser normalization only). No fix needed but worth noting.
admin_routes.delete_user cascade covers 6 collections; consider also purging any password-reset / email verification tokens if such collections exist in future.
Frontend still caches non-sensitive user object in localStorage under 'fishit_user' — expected per spec; not a security concern as no JWT is stored.
auth_routes.logout does not require authentication (no Depends(get_current_user)) — intentional (idempotent) but any caller can clear their own cookie. Acceptable.
test_credentials: user@fishit.app / FishIt#2026 (elite); admin@fishit.app / Admin@Fishit2026 (admin). Seeded elite + admin users preserved. Only a throwaway user deltest_ui_* was created and deleted.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: registered deltest_api_* and deltest_ui_* users during tests; all deleted by end of run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 12 verified the localStorage->httpOnly cookie migration and DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}. Full backend pytest suite should still pass (E1 reported 130/130). New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_cookie_auth_admin_delete.py.
